objective: SYNTHETIC worked cosmic-ray measurement spec (estimand, ledgers, backgrounds with control regions and closure, an active blinding mask); every value is invented
unresolved_inputs: closure: the closure test of the charge-confusion background is not run yet

extension.estimand: SYNTHETIC: the antiproton-to-proton flux ratio per rigidity bin from 10 to 400 GV at detector level, per period, for downward-going particles above the geomagnetic cutoff selection

phase_space.definition: SYNTHETIC: downward-going particles inside the acceptance, bin lower edge above the cutoff selection

normalization.convention: ratio of exposure-normalized fluxes; the exposure cancels per period

selections.name: geomagnetic
selections.definition: SYNTHETIC: bin lower edge above f x maximum cutoff

selections.name: negative-charge track
selections.definition: SYNTHETIC: track with negative curvature and quality requirements

validation.threshold: stable within its statistics per bin
validation.action: refit the confusion matrix per bin

backgrounds.name: charge-confused protons
backgrounds.estimator: 2x2 charge migration matrix inverted per bin
backgrounds.control_region: SYNTHETIC: high curvature-significance tail of positive tracks

backgrounds.name: misidentified electrons
backgrounds.estimator: template fit in the identification variable
backgrounds.closure: SYNTHETIC: template closure in a validation band of the identification variable

systematics.name: charge-confusion-rate
systematics.source: SYNTHETIC: tail modelling of the curvature significance
systematics.applied_via: vary the confusion matrix within its control-region uncertainty

systematics.name: antiproton-acceptance
systematics.applied_via: species-specific acceptance variation, not cancelling in the ratio

cancellations.correlation_model: identical live time and cutoff per period
cancellations.verification: by construction of the per-period exposure
